admission.justification: Reading the empty hook timeline would leave every hand-over unrecognised, so a seat's finished work would never wake its parent.

applicability: The plugin's reading of an ended turn on Paseo 0.13 and later.
conditions: The turn-ended hook supplies an empty timeline.
exclusions: Hosts before 0.13, whose hook carried the timeline.

evidence: plugin tests 250 pass / 1 skip ("Paseo 0.15.4 hook shape: the turn read through refetch recognises a hand-over"); notes/reports/260928-MIK-L60-evidence/partB/step-log.md hand-over row

statement: From Paseo 0.13 the turn-ended hook carries an empty timeline, so the plugin reads the ended turn through context.paseo.agents.ref(id).timeline.refetch and still recognises a hand-over.
